records.title: [Fix] spec: Keep chain MTP prefill hidden states under DP attention

events.body: @nvpohanh This one changes the same function as #47493, which you merged. Under DP attention, the `EAGLE_DRAFT_EXTEND` branch of `post_forward_mlp_sync_batch` cuts the hidden states to `[:bs]` even with FULL capture, so a chain MTP draft loses the prefill hidden rows its next step reads. The fix keeps `_original_num_tokens` rows for FULL capture. I rebased onto main to resolve the test conflict with #47493, and the new test still fails on current main. Could you review it and add `run-ci`?

records.title: [Fix] glm5_next: Gather DFlash aux hidden states for every scattered MoE all-to-all backend

events.body:
Thanks for the PR and the detailed validation results! One concern:

1. **Aux capture gathers already complete rows on UNPADDED batches** ([code](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/00fcb858a322981eadbc5703dd07d24aafcea180/python/sglang/srt/models/glm5_next.py#L1109)). With megamoe, attention DP disabled, `--disable-attn-tp-gather`, and eager DFLASH with block size 5, each attention-TP rank already holds the complete rows. The new gate gathers them again, and the verify reshape folds the duplicated rows into the feature dimension. I reproduced this with real CUDA/NCCL on 4×H100 using a nine-layer pretrained-weight fixture: the base generates 16 tokens, while this PR fails with `Expected shape [N, 20480], got shape=(5, 81920)`. Please decide whether to gather from the actual batch capture layout and add regression coverage for indivisible token counts.
